summary_en: Osaka Soda authorized acquisition of up to 5.0 million shares (4.2% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for up to ¥5.0 billion via market purchases including ToSTNeT-3, from November 11, 2026 to January 29, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, Osaka Soda's board of directors resolved to acquire treasury stock pursuant to Article 165(3) of the Companies Act, applied mutatis mutandis to Article 156. The company is authorized to acquire up to 5.0 million shares, representing 4.2% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, for an aggregate amount not to exceed ¥5.0 billion. The acquisition period runs from November 11, 2026 to January 29, 2027, and purchases will be executed via market purchases including transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange's off-exchange trading system for treasury stock (ToSTNeT-3).

The stated purpose is to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 13,394,413 treasury shares against 120,265,672 outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.
